# Darcy & Roy Press

> A peer-reviewed STM (Science, Technology, Medicine) academic publisher hosting multiple specialized journals across computing, energy, life sciences, and innovation.

Darcy & Roy Press operates an open journal system platform featuring peer-reviewed publications in diverse scientific and social science domains. The press is committed to publication ethics and research integrity standards aligned with COPE (Committee on Publication Ethics) guidelines.

## Key Topics

- Peer-reviewed journals
- STM publishing
- Academic publishing
- Publication ethics
- Research integrity
- COPE compliance
- Manuscript submission
- Plagiarism policy
- Author guidelines
- Frontiers in Computing and Intelligent Systems
- International Journal of Energy
- International Journal of Biology and Life Sciences
- Journal of Innovation and Development
- Academic Journal of Management and Social Sciences

## Core Publishing

- [Darcy & Roy Press](https://drpress.org/ojs/index.php/index/index): Darcy & Roy Press homepage showcasing peer-reviewed STM journals across computing, energy, life sciences, innovation, and social sciences.

## Publication Ethics & Standards

- [Publication Ethics](https://drpress.org/ojs/index.php/index/publicationethics): Publication ethics guidelines and COPE compliance standards for authors, covering research integrity, plagiarism policy, and manuscript submission requirements.
